create_ema_for_model: create an ExponentialMovingAverage instance for a PyTorch model with a specified decay rate
update_ema_after_step: update the ExponentialMovingAverage shadow parameters after calling optimizer.step()
copy_ema_to_model: copy the ExponentialMovingAverage shadow parameters back to the original model parameters
store_and_restore_params: store original model parameters before copying EMA weights then restore them after validation
save_load_ema_state: save the ExponentialMovingAverage state dict for checkpointing and load it to resume training
